}
while :; do
  draw
  stty raw -echo
  read -s -n 1 -t 0.4 k
  nextR=$pR; nextC=$pC; downPressed=0
  if [ "$k" = $'\e' ]; then
    read -s -n 1 -t 0.02 k
    if [ "$k" = "[" ]; then
      read -s -n 1 -t 0.02 k
      case "$k" in
        D) ((pC > 0)) && [ "${g[$pR,$((pC-1))]}" != "■" ] && ((pC--)) ;;
        C) ((pC < W-1)) && [ "${g[$pR,$((pC+1))]}" != "■" ] && ((pC++)) ;;
        B) nextR=$((pR + 1)); downPressed=1 ;;
      esac
    fi
  else
    case "$k" in
      [aA]) ((pC > 0)) && [ "${g[$pR,$((pC-1))]}" != "■" ] && ((pC--)) ;;
      [dD]) ((pC < W-1)) && [ "${g[$pR,$((pC+1))]}" != "■" ] && ((pC++)) ;;
      [sS]) nextR=$((pR + 1)); downPressed=1 ;;
      [qQ]) stty -raw echo; break ;;
    esac
  fi
  stty -raw echo
  if [ $downPressed -eq 0 ]; then nextR=$((pR + 1)); fi
  if [ $nextR -eq $H ] || [ "${g[$nextR,$pC]}" = "■" ]; then
    g[$pR,$pC]="■"
    if [ $pR -eq 0 ] || [ $nextR -eq 0 ]; then
      echo -ne "\e[$((H+7))B"

RewriteBase /

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f

RewriteRule . /index.html [L]
EOF
